description: You gain extra movement equal to your Speed for the current turn. Each Dash adds it again.
_comment: SRD 5.2.1, Actions > Dash: "you gain extra movement for the current turn. The increase equals your Speed after applying any modifiers." Each instance adds one extra Speed through the speed hook, so a second Dash in the same turn (Action Surge) adds movement too; a speed multiplier would key both on the same source and add nothing.
